                dfs(neighbor, node, d + 1)
                euler.append(node)
                depth.append(d)

    # Segment tree for GCD queries

            build_segment_tree(2 * node, start, mid)
            build_segment_tree(2 * node + 1, mid + 1, end)

    build_segment_tree(1, 0, len(euler) - 1)

        left_gcd = query_segment_tree(2 * node, start, mid, l, r)
        right_gcd = query_segment_tree(2 * node + 1, mid + 1, end, l, r)
